directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Place mixture on foil and form into a roll. Wrap tightly.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Unwrap and place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours, or until cooked through. Time may vary depending on the size of the roll.
Wrap a piece of bacon around each water chestnut and secure with a toothpick.
Place wraps in a baking pan uncovered and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Remove from oven and drain excess grease from the pan.
In a bowl, combine brown sugar and ketchup to make the sauce.
Pour sauce over the wraps and return to oven. Bake at 350°F for an additional 45 minutes.
Serve warm.
Place puffed popcorn in a large roasting pan.
In a 2-quart saucepan, combine butter, brown sugar, and corn syrup. Microwave for 2 minutes.
Stir and add baking soda.
Pour mixture over popcorn and mix until evenly coated.
Bake at 250°F for 45 minutes, stirring every 10–15 minutes.
Pour out onto wax paper to dry and break apart.
Soften cream cheese and mix together with onion, Accent, Worcestershire sauce, and 2 packages of chipped beef.
Form mixture into a ball.
Roll ball in the remaining package of chipped beef to coat.
Chill until ready to serve.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Blend crab meat (with liquid from the can), cream cheese, green onion, and garlic salt until smooth.
Place 1/2 tsp of filling on each wonton skin.
Fold wonton into a triangle and seal edges with egg white.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Serve with vegetables or crackers.
Mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Form into a ball and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Mix all ingredients together well.
Serve with crackers.
Melt butter and stir together with honey.
Combine all cereals and snacks in a large bowl or roasting pan.
Pour honey butter mixture over the cereal mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Spray 2 cookie sheets or a large pan and spread mixture out.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
After baking, pour mix onto parchment paper to prevent clumping. Let cool.

ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast (4½ tsp total)
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine 1½ cups flour, sugar, yeast, and all seasonings.
In a saucepan, heat milk, water, and 2 tbsp butter to 120–130°F. Add to dry ingredients and beat until moistened.
Add egg and beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and enough remaining flour to form a soft dough.
Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 3–5 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease the top. Cover and let rest 15 minutes.
Punch dough down. Divide into 16 pieces and shape each into a ball.
Melt remaining butter. Dip tops of balls in butter, then in remaining Parmesan cheese.
Place in a greased 13x9-inch pan. Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to a wire rack.
Mix cream cheese, mayo, green chilies, and jalapenos together until combined.
Spread into a baking pan.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the top.
Bake at 300°F until cheese is golden brown.
Serve with crackers.
Mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Form into a ball.
Serve with crackers.

ingredients: 1 pkg original Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Mix Crisco oil, dill, garlic powder, and ranch dressing mix together.
Pour over oyster crackers and toss to coat evenly.
Spread on wax paper and allow to dry.
Combine cereals, pretzels, and nuts in a large roasting pan.
Melt butter and stir in Worcestershire sauce and seasonings.
Pour butter mixture over cereal mixture and stir well.
Bake at 200°F for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Pour onto wax paper to cool and prevent clumping.

components.name: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix all ball ingredients together until well combined.
Form into balls and refrigerate until firm.

components.name: Chocolate Coating
directions: Melt chocolate chips and Crisco together.
Dip chilled balls into chocolate to coat.
Place on wax paper and refrigerate until set.
Combine pina colada mix, 1/4 cup water, pineapple, coconut, and powdered sugar in a saucepan.
Heat over medium-low, stirring frequently, until the sauce begins to simmer.
Let simmer for 10–12 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with 3 tsp cold water. Add to sauce and blend well.
Let simmer an additional 3–5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and bring to room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers.
Place cereal in a large clean brown paper bag.
Melt chocolate chips, butter, and peanut butter together in the microwave.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour mixture into the paper bag. Fold top over and shake well until cereal is coated.
Add powdered sugar and shake again to coat.
Pour onto wax paper to dry and cool.
Mix all ingredients together.
Heat thoroughly, stirring often.
Keep warm in a crock pot or on the stove. Serve with crackers or rye bread.

ingredients: 1 pkg Hidden Valley party dip mix
directions: Mix oil, dill weed, garlic powder, and dip mix together.
Pour over oyster crackers and toss to coat well.
Spread on wax paper to dry.
Combine all snack ingredients in a large bag or roasting pan.
Pour oil and ranch dressing mix over top and mix thoroughly.
Spread half the mix in a roasting pan. Bake at 250°F for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Repeat with second half.
Cool on wax paper.

ingredients: 3/4 of a bunch of celery, chopped
directions: Sauté onions and celery in margarine until softened.
Mix bread crumbs with 4 cans of broth. Let sit about 20 minutes so crumbs soak up broth.
Add cooked rice and onion mixture. Stir to combine.
If mixture is dry, add more broth as needed.
Bake at 350°F for 1½ hours.

ingredients: 1 cup sour cream + 1 pkg chili seasoning + 3/4 cup Miracle Whip (mixed together)
directions: In a large pan, spread refried beans as the first layer.
Spread avocado dip over the beans.
Mix together sour cream, chili seasoning, and Miracle Whip. Spread over avocado dip.
Top with olives, onions, and tomatoes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the top.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with chips.
Mix cream cheese and ranch packet together until smooth.
Chop and prepare all vegetables.
Mix vegetables into the cream cheese mixture.
Spread mixture onto tortilla shells and roll up tightly.
Refrigerate for at least one day.
Slice into rounds and serve.
Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Store in an airtight container.
Melt butter over low heat on the stove.
Add flour and stir to combine.
Add milk and whisk together.
Add salt and whisk to incorporate.
Keep over low heat, stirring continuously, until sauce thickens.

title: 6 Week Refrigerator Bran Muffins

directions: Mix all ingredients together until combined.
Fill greased muffin tins.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.

notes: Unused batter can be stored covered in the refrigerator for up to 6 weeks and baked as needed.

directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
Add flour, baking soda, and salt. Stir to combine.
Fold in nuts and mashed bananas.
Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Knead all ingredients together for 4–5 minutes.
Place dough in greased pans and let rise until doubled.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.
Combine 2 cups flour, sugar, shortening, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
Add warm water, warm milk, and egg. Beat with electric mixer.
Add remaining flour and mix until a dough forms.
Place dough in a greased bowl and let rise until doubled.
Shape into rolls and place in greased pans.
Bake at 400°F for 12–18 minutes.

ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast (4½ tsp total)
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine 1½ cups flour, sugar, yeast, and all seasonings.
In a saucepan, heat milk, water, and 2 tbsp butter to 120–130°F. Add to dry ingredients and beat until moistened.
Add egg and beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan and enough remaining flour to form a soft dough.
Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 3–5 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once. Cover and let rest 15 minutes.
Punch dough down. Divide into 16 pieces and shape into balls.
Melt remaining butter. Dip tops in butter, then in remaining Parmesan cheese.
Place in a greased 13x9-inch pan. Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

ingredients: 1 can pie filling (flavor of your choice)
directions: Warm milk and stir in yeast and sugar until dissolved.
Add melted margarine and beaten egg.
Add salt and flour. Mix to form a dough.
Let rise until doubled in size.
Form into balls and place on baking sheets. Let rise again.
Gently press down the center of each ball and place 1 tsp of pie filling in the indent.
Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
Cool on a rack and drizzle with frosting.
Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Add remaining ingredients and mix until combined.
Place dough in greased pans and let rise until doubled.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins

directions: Mix all dry ingredients together.
Add eggs, buttermilk, and oil. Stir until combined.
Fill greased muffin tins.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

notes: Batter keeps refrigerated for 1 month or more. Bake as needed.

components.name: Muffins
directions: Mix all muffin ingredients together in order.
Pour into 24 muffin tins lined with paper cups or sprayed with cooking spray.

components.name: Topping
directions: Mix topping ingredients with a fork until crumbly.
Sprinkle over muffins.
Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add egg, salt, sugar, lard, and half the flour. Mix with a mixer.
Add remaining flour and turn out onto a cutting board. Knead for 5 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl and let rise until doubled.
Shape into rolls and let rise again.
Bake at 350°F until done.
Soften yeast in warm water. Add sugar, salt, and white flour. Beat until smooth.
Set in a warm place until light and bubbly.
Combine hot water with brown sugar and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.
Combine both mixtures. Add whole wheat flour and mix until smooth.
Knead until smooth and elastic. Let rise until doubled.
Place in greased loaf pans and let rise until doubled again.
Bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.

ingredients: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen peas (do not thaw)
directions: In a 9x13 pan, layer lettuce, celery, green pepper, frozen peas, and onion in that order. Do not defrost the peas.
Mix mayo and sugar together and spread over the top.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over all.
Chill overnight before serving.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add all ingredients to the pan.
Fry until vegetables are tender.
Beat eggs. Add sour cream, oleo, onion, salt, pepper, and cornbread mix. Stir to combine.
Add corn and about 1 cup of water. Stir.
Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.
Remove from oven, top with shredded cheese, and bake an additional 20 minutes.
Cut up broccoli, cauliflower, and onion and combine in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix mayo, vinegar, and sugar.
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss to coat.
Add bacon bits and mix. Refrigerate before serving.
Combine cabbage, carrots, onion, and pepper in a large bowl. Set aside.
In a saucepan, bring vinegar, water, mustard seed, celery seed, and sugar to a boil. Stir and boil for 1 minute.
Cool liquid to lukewarm.
Pour over cabbage mixture and refrigerate.
Wash cranberries and remove any bad ones.
Blend cranberries and oranges in a blender, a little at a time.
Pour into a bowl, stir in sugar, and let marinate for several hours or overnight.
Dissolve raspberry jello in 2½ cups of water. Let cool.
Stir cranberry mixture into cooled jello.
Refrigerate until set.
Mix sugar, vinegar, mayo, and Cool Whip together until smooth.
Add coleslaw mix and blend well.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Soak sliced cucumbers in salt water for about 2 hours, then rinse.
Boil water, sugar, and vinegar together. Remove from heat and let cool.
Pour cooled liquid over cucumbers and onions.
Let sit in refrigerator for about a day before serving.
Cook and dice potatoes.
In a large skillet, crisp bacon. Remove bacon and cook onion in the bacon fat until golden.
Add flour, sugar, salt, celery seed, and pepper. Cook over low heat until bubbly.
Stir in water and vinegar. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Crumble bacon and add along with potatoes. Heat through, coating all potatoes. Serve warm.
Cook rice according to package directions and let cool.
Mix together cooked rice, pineapple, sugar, prepared jello, and Cool Whip.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Heat crushed pineapple (with juice) and dissolve lime jello in it. Let cool.
Beat cream cheese and Cool Whip together until smooth.
Stir celery into the cream cheese mixture.
Add cooled jello and pineapple mixture. Stir to combine.
Refrigerate until set. Serve chilled.
Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse in cold water and drain.
Add onion, green pepper, and carrots to macaroni.
Mix together Miracle Whip, sugar, condensed milk, and vinegar.
Pour dressing over macaroni mixture and mix well.
Refrigerate before serving.
Boil potatoes until tender. Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, sour cream, and Parmesan cheese together.
Cut potatoes in half.
Top each half with a dollop of the cream mixture, crumbled bacon, and chives.
Pat ham slices dry.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on each slice of ham.
Place a pickle at one end and roll the ham tightly around it.
Slice each roll into rounds. Repeat for all rolls.
Boil and drain potatoes. Set aside to cool completely.
Hard boil eggs, peel, and set aside to cool completely.
When potatoes and eggs are fully cold, shred or chop them.
Mix together eggs, potatoes, and onions.
Add Miracle Whip and mustard and stir together.
Add sugar a little at a time, tasting as you go, until desired sweetness.

ingredients: 1 pkg Hidden Valley Buttermilk Ranch mix
directions: Place mushrooms in a crock pot.
Pour melted butter and ranch mix over mushrooms.
Set crock pot to high.
Cook, stirring every 10 minutes, until mushrooms are tender.

ingredients: 1 can pie filling (flavor of your choice)
directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Chill in the refrigerator before serving.
Combine pineapple and water and heat to a boil.
Dissolve lemon and orange jello in the hot pineapple mixture.
Let cool slightly, then stir in celery, nuts, whipped cream, carrots, cottage cheese, and Spin Blend.
Refrigerate until set.

ingredients: 6–8 Snickers bars, cut into small pieces
directions: Mix buttermilk, Cool Whip, and dry pudding mix together.
Add cut Snickers, apples, and marshmallows.
Mix well and refrigerate before serving.
Remove stems from mushrooms and chop the stems finely.
Sauté stems, minced garlic, and onion in oil until tender.
Remove from heat and mix with cream cheese, Parmesan, shredded cheese, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Fill each mushroom cap with the filling.
Bake at 375°F for 15–20 minutes.
Cut up tomatoes, cucumber, and onion.
Mix in Miracle Whip, milk, and sugar to taste.
Stir and serve.
Mix Miracle Whip and milk together.
Stir in stuffing mix, broccoli, and cheese.
Spoon into a greased 11x7 pan.
Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
Brown ground beef and onion together. Drain.
Mix all ingredients together in a large baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

ingredients: 1 can pork and beans with juice
directions: Cook bacon, onion, and ground beef together. Drain.
Add brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add all four cans of beans with their liquid and mix well.
Bake at 300°F for 1½ hours.
Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased baking pan.
Bake at 350°F for 35–45 minutes.

ingredients: 1 pkg frozen broccoli and cauliflower, thawed
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
In a greased 9x13 pan, spread uncooked macaroni in an even layer.
Layer cheese slices over the macaroni.
Place diced chicken on top of the cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix cream of chicken soup with milk and pour over everything.
Bake at 350°F for 1¼ hours.

ingredients: 2⅛ cups Morton Tender Quick salt (use 1 cup per 5 lbs of turkey)
directions: Place turkey in a cooler and cover with water.
Add Tender Quick salt (1 cup per 5 lbs of turkey).
Let sit in a cool area for 24–48 hours.
Rinse turkey well and place in roasting pan to cook as desired.
Grease a 9x13 pan.
Layer croutons, then shredded cheese, then browned sausage in the pan.
Mix eggs with milk, salt, and pepper. Pour over layers.
Bake at 350°F for at least 1 hour, until eggs are fully set and firm.

components.name: Chicken
ingredients: 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips
directions: In a small bowl, whisk together chili powder, smoked paprika, brown sugar, cumin, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
In a medium bowl, combine chicken strips with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and the seasoning blend. Toss to coat evenly.
Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray. Spread chicken in a single layer.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.

components.name: Street Corn Mixture
ingredients: 3 ears sweet corn, cut off the cob
directions: In a bowl, mix together all corn mixture ingredients.
After chicken has baked 15 minutes, nestle corn mixture around the chicken on the sheet pan.
Return to oven and bake another 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and corn is tender.
Turn broiler to high and broil 1–2 minutes to lightly crisp tops.

components.name: To Serve
ingredients: Optional: sliced jalapeños, avocado, hot sauce
directions: Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining Cotija cheese.
Serve with warm tortillas, lime wedges, and desired toppings.

components.name: Ham Balls
directions: Mix all ball ingredients together.
Form into balls and place in a baking pan.

components.name: Sauce
directions: Mix all sauce ingredients together and pour over ham balls.
Bake at 350°F for 90 minutes.
Grease a 9x13 pan.
In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients except margarine.
Spread mixture into the pan.
Place margarine pieces on top of the potatoes.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

components.name: Waffles
directions: Mix all waffle ingredients together until combined.
Cook in a waffle iron according to manufacturer directions.

components.name: Maple Syrup
directions: Combine all syrup ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and cook for about 5 minutes.
Serve warm over waffles.

title: Hot Turkey Sandwich

directions: Roast turkey until fully cooked. Pick meat from bones and chop.
Grind onions and celery.
Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.
Bake at 350°F for 2 hours.
Serve on burger buns.

notes: Makes approximately 100 servings on burger buns.

ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 lb smoked sausage, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and all-purpose seasoning. Cook in oil in a large pot over medium heat until browned and cooked through.
Remove chicken from pot, preserving the oil.
Sauté onions and garlic in remaining oil for 3–4 minutes.
Add bell pepper, celery, parsley, and scallions. Sauté until onions are transparent, about 10 minutes.
Add sausage, rice, broth, chicken, salt, cayenne, bay leaves, thyme, and gumbo filé if using.
Cook over medium heat until nearly all water is absorbed into the rice, about 15–20 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is done, at least 1 hour.
Remove bay leaves before serving.
Brown hamburger, drain, and add spaghetti sauce. Stir to combine.
Mix eggs and cottage cheese together in a bowl.
In a 9x13 pan, spread a thin layer of meat sauce on the bottom.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, cottage cheese mixture, and shredded cheese.
Repeat layers until all ingredients are used, ending with cheese on top.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Combine muffin mix with flour in a large bowl.
Stir in eggs, milk, and melted margarine.
Season batter with chili powder, cumin, Tabasco, and onion. Batter will be thick.
Roll hot dogs in batter until coated about 1/2 inch thick.
Place on a nonstick cookie sheet.
Bake at 425°F for 12–15 minutes or until deep golden brown.

components.name: Chicken
ingredients: Vegetable or canola oil for frying
directions: Whisk together milk, peanut butter, and egg. Add a few dashes of salt and pepper.
Soak chicken in this mixture for a few minutes.
Coat soaked chicken in crushed corn flakes.
Cook in oil in a skillet, flipping once, until browned on both sides and cooked through. Alternatively, bake at 375°F for approximately 12 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.

components.name: Peanut Butter Sauce
directions: Combine all sauce ingredients in a microwave-safe container.
Microwave for 30 seconds, whisk, then microwave another 30 seconds until hot.
Add more water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Drizzle over chicken when serving. Serve with rice and vegetables.

ingredients: 1 rack pork loin back ribs (baby back)
1 cup barbecue sauce, plus more for brushing
directions: Remove the membrane from the back of the rack of ribs.
Season both sides of the ribs with the rub.
Cut between bones to separate into 4 portions to fit in a pressure cooker.
Place ribs in pressure cooker with root beer. Lock lid and cook on high pressure (Beef/Pork setting) for 30 minutes.
Let steam release naturally for 10 minutes, then manually release remaining pressure.
Remove ribs, brush with barbecue sauce, and broil in the oven on high for 3–5 minutes until slightly crisped.
Pour barbecue sauce into the pot with the remaining juices. Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve alongside ribs.

ingredients: 1 cup or more cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Brown ground beef and onion. Drain and season with salt and pepper.
Cook noodles according to package directions.
In a casserole dish, layer half the meat, then the sauerkraut, then remaining meat.
Add noodles over the top and cover with both soups.
Cover and bake at 300°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, top with shredded cheese, and bake an additional 20 minutes.

ingredients: 2 cups noodles or 2 cups cooked rice
directions: Brown hamburger and drain well.
Cook noodles if using, according to package directions.
Combine hamburger, noodles or rice, corn, and soup.
Stir together and heat through. Serve warm.
Brown hamburger with onions. Drain.
Add ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, and vinegar.
Stir together and simmer until heated through. Serve on buns.

components.name: Sloppy Joe
ingredients: 1 sloppy joe seasoning packet (or: 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp celery seed, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1/4 tsp dry mustard, 1 tbsp chili powder)
directions: Brown meat over medium-high heat. Drain liquid.
Add remaining sloppy joe ingredients and simmer covered on medium-low heat for 30+ minutes, stirring occasionally.

components.name: Mac and Cheese
directions: Cook noodles al dente (about 6 minutes). Drain and set aside.
Melt butter over low heat 2–4 minutes. Slowly mix in flour and cook on low-medium, stirring constantly, until slightly lighter than peanut butter color.
Slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium-low.
Add Velveeta and all but 1/2 cup cheddar. Stir until melted, about 3–5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in noodles.
Spread mac and cheese into a greased 9x13 pan. Top with sloppy joe mixture, covering completely.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle remaining cheese on top, and let sit 5 minutes until melted.

components.name: Meatballs
directions: Mix all meatball ingredients together.
Roll into balls and place in a roasting pan.

components.name: Sauce
directions: Mix sauce ingredients together and pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 300°F for 90 minutes.

ingredients: 8 ready-to-eat turkey breakfast links, cut in half
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring, until softened (about 2 minutes).
Add sausage and cook until lightly browned. Drain pooled grease.
Add chilies, chili powder, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, and salt. Cook for about 20 minutes.
Pour in beaten eggs and cook while stirring until scrambled and cooked through.
Mix all ingredients together until combined.
Pour batter onto a hot greased griddle or skillet to desired size.
Cook until bubbles form on surface, then flip and cook until done.

components.name: Crust
directions: Stir together flour and salt. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until crumbly.
Mix in cold water a little at a time until dough holds together.
Divide dough in half. Roll out one half to fit a 10x15-inch jelly roll pan.

components.name: Filling
directions: Mix sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg together. Toss with apples.
Spread apple mixture over crust in the jelly roll pan.
Roll out remaining dough and place over top as the top crust.
Sprinkle with a little extra cinnamon and sugar.
Bake at 400°F for 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Banana Pie

components.name: Filling
directions: Heat milk in a double boiler.
In a separate bowl, mix sugar, cornstarch, and egg yolks.
Pour sugar mixture into the hot milk and stir until thickened.
Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and butter.
Add bananas to pudding and pour into a baked pie crust.

components.name: Meringue Topping
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add vanilla and sugar, then beat until stiff again.
Spread over pie filling.
Bake at 400°F until meringue is golden brown.

notes: If not adding meringue topping, no baking is required — just chill and serve.

components.name: Filling
directions: Heat 2½ cups milk in a double boiler until boiling.
In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup milk, sugar, egg yolks, and cornstarch until smooth.
Slowly pour mixture into the boiling milk in the double boiler, stirring constantly until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, vanilla, and sliced bananas.
Pour into baked pie shell.

components.name: Meringue
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar and vanilla.
Spread over pie filling.
Bake at 400°F until meringue is golden brown.

components.name: Brownies
directions: Combine flour, sugar, salt, and cocoa in a bowl. Set aside.
Bring water, margarine, and oil to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat.
Stir in milk, baking soda, eggs, and vanilla. Beat until well mixed.
Add flour mixture and mix well.
Pour into a greased 12x15 pan and bake at 350°F for about 18 minutes.

components.name: Frosting
directions: Bring sugar, milk, and margarine to a boil. Remove from heat.
Add chocolate chips and beat until the mixture begins to thicken.
Spread over warm brownies.
Lightly butter the bottom and sides of a 9x9x2-inch pan.
Melt butter in a heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and salt and stir.
Stir in corn syrup. Gradually pour in sweetened condensed milk, stirring constantly.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, to 245°F on a candy thermometer.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
Immediately pour into prepared pan. Cool on a wire rack.
When fully cooled, cut into squares. Dip knife in water between cuts if needed.
Wrap each caramel in plastic wrap and store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
Melt Velveeta and butter together until smooth.
Mix powdered sugar, cocoa, vanilla, and nuts together.
Combine both mixtures and spread into a greased cookie sheet.
Chill and cut into squares.

title: Chocolate Meltaways

directions: Cream butter. Add powdered sugar and vanilla.
Stir in sifted flour and salt.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler or microwave. Add to dough and mix until well blended.
Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 250°F for 60 minutes. Do not underbake.

notes: Doubles well. According to family legend, these come out best in a gas oven.

components.name: Dough
directions: Mix warm water, sugar, and yeast together. Let sit 5 minutes.
Add flour and salt. Mix until smooth and let rise 10 minutes.
Roll dough into a 12-inch circle and place on a greased 12-inch pizza pan.

components.name: Cinnamon Sugar Spread
directions: Combine all spread ingredients in a bowl.
Spread thinly over the dough. Sprinkle with additional brown sugar if desired.
Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes until edges are lightly golden.

components.name: Cream Cheese Glaze
directions: Beat butter and cream cheese together until smooth.
Add powdered sugar and vanilla and mix until combined. Microwave briefly if too thick.
Drizzle over warm pizza and serve.
Mix all ingredients together until a dough forms.
Let rise until doubled in size.
Shape into rolls and let rise again.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

components.name: Crust
directions: Mix flour, sugar, and salt. Cut in butter and shortening until crumbly.
Gradually add ice water, tossing with a fork until dough holds together.
Divide into two disks, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate 30 minutes.

components.name: Filling
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen cranberries, divided
6 medium baking apples (about 2 lbs), peeled and thinly sliced
directions: Soak currants in rum for 20 minutes.
Pulse 3/4 cup cranberries and 1/4 cup sugar in a food processor until coarsely chopped. Transfer to a bowl.
Add apples, tapioca, lemon juice, lemon peel, cinnamon, remaining sugar, and currant mixture. Toss and let stand 15 minutes.
Roll one dough disk to 1/8-inch thickness and transfer to a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate. Trim edges.
Add filling. Roll remaining dough and cut into 1/2-inch strips. Arrange in a lattice pattern over filling. Trim, seal, and flute edges. Place remaining cranberries in spaces of lattice.
Whisk 1 egg with 1 tbsp milk; brush over lattice. Mix 2 tsp sugar with a dash of cinnamon; sprinkle over.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes. Reduce to 325°F and bake 40–45 more minutes until golden and bubbly.
Cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes before serving warm.
Cook sugar, corn syrup, and water in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.
Continue cooking without stirring to 260°F on a candy thermometer (hard ball stage).
Beat egg whites in a separate bowl until stiff peaks form.
Continue beating while slowly pouring hot syrup in a thin stream into egg whites.
Add flavoring and beat until mixture holds its shape and becomes slightly dull. This may take a while and may become too stiff for a mixer.
Fold in nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls from a buttered spoon onto waxed paper. Let stand at room temperature until set.
Store in an airtight container.

title: Marzipan

directions: Mix almond paste, corn syrup, marshmallow creme, and rum or almond extract together.
Gradually mix in powdered sugar until the mixture is smooth and pliable enough to mold.
Divide into sections and color with food coloring based on desired fruit shapes.
Shape into fruits such as strawberries, bananas, apples, oranges, pears, grapes, pumpkins, or potatoes.
Use toothpicks to add detail lines. Roll potatoes in cocoa powder for a brown coating. Roll strawberries in red sugar for seeds.
Store in an airtight container.

notes: Keeps about one to two months in an airtight container.

directions: Beat cream cheese, butter, vanilla, and peanut butter together until smooth.
Stir in brown sugar and powdered sugar and mix well.
Fold in oats, M&Ms, and chocolate chips.
Serve with pretzels, graham cracker sticks, or strawberries.

title: Monster Cookies

directions: Mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Drop by spoonfuls onto baking sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 9–11 minutes or until done.

notes: This is a very large batch. Recipe can be scaled down.

components.name: Cobbler Batter
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter or vegetable oil
directions: In a medium bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and spices.
In a separate bowl, stir together pumpkin, milk, melted butter, and vanilla.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and mix to create a thick batter.
Pour into a small 8-inch casserole dish with high sides.

components.name: Topping
directions: Stir sugars and pecans together and spread evenly over the batter.
Pour hot water over everything WITHOUT stirring.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes or until middle is set.
Cool 5–10 minutes before serving. Serve with vanilla ice cream and additional pecans.

components.name: Pumpkin Layer
directions: Beat eggs, sugars, flour, pie spice, and salt until smooth.
Mix in pumpkin. Gradually beat in milk.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 425°F for 10 minutes, then reduce temperature to 350°F and bake 15 more minutes.

components.name: Pecan Topping
directions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add corn syrup, brown sugar, molasses, flour, vanilla, and salt.
Pour over the pumpkin filling.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans and cover with pecan halves.
Bake at 350°F for 30–35 minutes or until set.
Cool completely. Store in the refrigerator.
In a double boiler, boil rice and milk together, stirring often, until rice thickens.
Add sugar and continue cooking for another 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in margarine and vanilla.
Sprinkle cinnamon over the top before serving.
Mix margarine, vanilla, water, flour, and nuts together until combined.
Place by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300°F for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
While still warm, roll in powdered sugar.

ingredients: 2 tbsp sugar + 2 tsp ground cinnamon (for rolling)
directions: Cream together butter, shortening, 1½ cups sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Blend in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, and salt.
Mix 2 tbsp sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl.
Shape dough by rounded spoonfuls into balls. Roll each in cinnamon sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 400°F for 8–10 minutes until set but not too hard.
Remove immediately to a cooling rack.

components.name: Layer 1 – Chocolate Base
directions: Melt together and spread in a 9x13 pan. Place in freezer until set.

components.name: Layer 2 – Nougat
directions: Boil sugar, margarine, and milk together for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter, marshmallow creme, vanilla, and peanuts.
Spread over Layer 1 and return to freezer until set.

components.name: Layer 3 – Caramel
directions: Melt caramels and milk together.
Spread over Layer 2 and return to freezer until set.

components.name: Layer 4 – Chocolate Top
directions: Melt together and spread over the caramel layer.
Return to freezer. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

components.name: Crust
directions: Combine melted butter, graham cracker crumbs, and sugar.
Press onto the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

components.name: Cheesecake
ingredients: Fresh strawberries pureed with a small amount of cornstarch, cooked until thickened and cooled
directions: Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla at medium speed until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
Pour half the batter over the baked crust.
Drop spoonfuls of half the strawberry puree over the batter. Pour in remaining batter, then add remaining puree by spoonfuls.
Swirl with a knife to create a marbled effect.
Bake at 300°F for 50–60 minutes or until set.
Cool completely, remove from springform rim, and chill overnight before serving.

components.name: Crust
directions: Melt butter and mix in powdered sugar and flour.
Press out onto a pizza pan or baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool completely before adding filling.

components.name: Filling
directions: Mix cream cheese, vanilla, Cool Whip, and powdered sugar until smooth.
Spread over cooled crust.
Top with sliced strawberries and serve.

components.name: Strawberry Rhubarb Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and set aside.

components.name: Cake
directions: Spray the inside of a Bundt pan with cooking spray.
Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking powder. In another bowl, mix yogurt and milk.
Alternate adding flour mixture and yogurt mixture to the butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Place clumps of batter in the bottom of the pan, followed by the strawberry rhubarb mixture. Repeat layers until finished.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes in pan, then invert onto a plate.

components.name: Cake
directions: Melt margarine with cocoa and water. Bring to a boil.
Combine with flour and sugar, then add eggs, buttermilk, salt, baking soda, and vanilla.
Pour into a greased 11x8x1-inch pan.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

components.name: Icing
directions: Combine margarine, cocoa, and milk and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Spread over cake while cake is still warm.
Mix all ingredients together for 3–4 minutes until well combined.
Divide into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes.

components.name: Cake
directions: Mix all cake ingredients together.
Pour into a greased 9x13 pan.
Bake at 300°F for about 1½ hours or until done.

components.name: Frosting
directions: Beat all frosting ingredients together until smooth.
Spread over cooled cake.

ingredients: Enough apples to fill 7 quart jars, peeled and sliced
directions: Fill 7 quart jars with peeled and sliced apples.
Combine water, sugar, cornstarch, apple pie spice, and margarine in a saucepan. Cook filling until thickened.
Pour filling equally over apples in jars.
Place filled jars in hot water in a pressure canner.
Pressure can for 10 minutes at 5 pounds of pressure.
Cool in canner, then remove and store.
Mix all ingredients together in a large pot.
Bring to a boil and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Ladle into sterilized jars and seal.
Place 2 garlic cloves and fresh dill in each jar.
Pack cucumbers tightly into jars.
Add alum to the top of the cucumbers in each jar.
Bring water, pickling salt, and vinegar to a rapid boil.
Pour hot brine into jars and seal.

ingredients: Spice bag: 1 tsp allspice, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp whole cloves, 1 tsp celery spice
directions: Cook beets until tender. Cool and peel.
Combine water, vinegar, and sugar. Tie allspice, black pepper, cloves, and celery spice in a small cloth bag and add to the brine along with the cinnamon stick.
Bring brine to a boil.
Pack beets into sterilized jars.
Pour hot brine over beets and seal jars.
Mix rhubarb, strawberries, and sugar together. Let stand for about 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, then cook for 12 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in strawberry jello until dissolved.
Pour into glasses or jars and seal.
Boil zucchini and water together for 8 minutes.
Add lemon juice, sugar, and pineapple. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Boil for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in apricot jello until dissolved.
Pour into freezer containers and freeze.

ingredients: Buffalo or wing sauce to taste
directions: Mix cream cheese, shredded chicken, and wing sauce together until combined.
Place in a crock pot to warm.
Serve with crackers, chips, or bread.
Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend together until desired consistency.
Serve cold.
Mix all ingredients together until a dough forms.
Roll out dough between two sheets of wax paper.
Peel off top sheet and transfer to pie plate.
